idea-plugin.name: DataSQRL
idea-plugin.description:
Support for DataSQRL scripts (.sqrl), from the SQRL compiler:
  • errors and warnings as you type, also of package files and GraphQL schemas
  • completion, documentation and validation of package files with their JSON schema
  • syntax highlighting, and the coloring of tables, functions, relationships and columns
  • completion of tables, columns, functions, imports, hints and template variables
  • documentation of tables, columns and functions, the signatures of functions as you type their arguments, and the types of computed columns inline
  • go to definition, go to symbol, find usages, and highlighting of usages
  • renaming of tables, functions and relationships, also in the GraphQL schema
  • quick fixes for common errors
  • running the tests of a project from above its test tables
  • the structure of scripts
  • the choice of the package file of a script, when several name it as their main script, in the DataSQRL item of the language services in the status bar
The compiler runs in the Docker image of the DataSQRL CLI, or from its jar, which can be set in Settings | Languages & Frameworks | DataSQRL.
